@expo/ui.reason: Keep the current native runtime; 57.0.20 adds SwiftUI toolbar/scroll-edge APIs and Android palette caching, requiring a coordinated native release.

@sentry/react-native.reason: Keep the Sentry 8 integration and its native crash symbol configuration.

expo.reason: Keep the tested runtime dependency tree. 57.0.25 advances expo-modules-core to 57.0.19 with native Host, Compose and worklet fixes that require a separate runtime release.

expo-background-task.reason: 57.0.20 refreshes release metadata and the task-manager floor only; native implementation and Android artifacts are identical. Keep the current runtime pair until the next native release.

expo-build-properties.reason: 57.0.22 changes release metadata only; plugin source and generated JavaScript are identical. Keep the current native build configuration for this runtime.

expo-glass-effect.reason: Defer the native iOS fix for glass rendering under an initially transparent ancestor to the next runtime release; the current ScrollProgress implementation is unchanged.

expo-insights.reason: 57.0.20 changes release metadata only; implementation, native dependencies and Android artifacts are identical. Retain the current native runtime.

expo-linking.reason: 57.0.11 has identical implementation and raises only the expo-constants floor, already met by installed 57.0.19; retain the current native runtime.

expo-location.reason: 57.0.20 has identical implementation and dependency requirements; its version and prebuilt artifact refresh can join the next native runtime release.

expo-notifications.reason: 57.0.21 has identical implementation and dependency requirements; its version and prebuilt artifact refresh can join the next native runtime release.

expo-router.reason: 57.0.23 has identical implementation and raises UI, glass-effect and linking floors; keep the coherent current native set until a coordinated runtime release.

expo-task-manager.reason: 57.0.20 changes release metadata only; implementation, native dependencies and Android artifacts are identical. Keep it paired with the current background-task runtime.

react.reason: Keep React aligned with React DOM and the test renderer; native validation is required with RN 0.86.3.

react-dom.reason: Match React 19.3.0 for the web application.

react-native-gesture-handler.reason: Keep the existing Gesture Handler 3 integration with RN 0.86.

react-native-reanimated.reason: Reanimated 4.5 supports RN 0.86 and Worklets 0.11; the 4.7/0.13 upgrade fails Hosting server rendering because requestAnimationFrame is unavailable.

react-native-worklets.reason: Keep the RN 0.86-compatible partner for Reanimated 4.5.5; Worklets 0.13 fails Hosting server rendering because requestAnimationFrame is unavailable, and 0.12 also lacks the server fallback.

react-native-safe-area-context.reason: Retain the current native safe-area integration.

react-native-screens.reason: Retain the current Screens 4 integration with Expo Router.

react-native-webview.reason: Retain the current WebView 14 player integration.
